description: This file defines the RenderableFtlSequence class, which composes multiple RenderableFtl objects into a sequence. It includes a builder for creating instances and implements an accept method for visitor pattern support.

classes.name: RenderableFtlSequence
classes.description: Class for composing multiple RenderableFtl objects in a sequence.

classes.name: RenderableFtlSequenceBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing RenderableFtlSequence instances.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a RenderableFtlVisitor and applies it to each RenderableFtl in the sequence.

methods.name: builder
methods.description: Static method to obtain a new RenderableFtlSequenceBuilder instance.

methods.name: renderableFtl
methods.description: Adds a RenderableFtl object to the sequence during building.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns a RenderableFtlSequence object.
